desc.en: A free no-code app builder. It provides complete access to the automatically generated backend source code and allows for unlimited APIs and routes. The free plan includes three projects and five tables.
desc.zh: 免费的无代码应用构建器。可完全访问自动生成的后端源代码，并允许不限数量的 API 和路由。免费套餐含 3 个项目和 5 张表。

desc.en: Converts Figma designs into dynamic Flutter and React applications. Its code generation technology is designed to optimize workflows for building production-ready mobile and web experiences.
desc.zh: 将 Figma 设计转换为动态的 Flutter 和 React 应用。其代码生成技术旨在优化构建生产级移动和 Web 体验的工作流。

desc.en: An AI-powered site builder and editor that generates production-ready frontend code from text prompts, sketches, or resumes. Features include native Android (APK) export and a free tier with 5 generations per month (unlimited via custom Gemini API key).
desc.zh: AI 驱动的网站构建器和编辑器，可根据文本提示、草图或简历生成生产级前端代码。功能包括原生 Android（APK）导出，免费套餐每月可生成 5 次（使用自定义 Gemini API 密钥则不限次数）。

desc.en: A C#-specific tool that generates boilerplate code on the fly during compilation to keep source code clean. It is free for open-source projects; its commercial-friendly free tier includes up to three aspects.
desc.zh: 一款专用于 C# 的工具，在编译期间动态生成样板代码以保持源代码整洁。开源项目免费；其对商业友好的免费套餐最多包含 3 个 aspect。

desc.en: A high-speed AI code completion plugin for VS Code, JetBrains, and Neovim. The free tier provides unlimited inline completions with a focus on ultra-low latency.
desc.zh: 适用于 VS Code、JetBrains 和 Neovim 的高速 AI 代码补全插件。免费套餐提供不限数量的内联补全，专注于超低延迟。

desc.en: Created by Vercel, v0 generates copy-and-paste friendly React code using shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS. It uses a credit system, providing 1,200 starting credits and 200 free credits monthly.
desc.zh: 由 Vercel 创建，v0 使用 shadcn/ui 和 Tailwind CSS 生成便于复制粘贴的 React 代码。它采用积分制，提供 1,200 初始积分和每月 200 免费积分。
